name: Komori Gin
source:
The owner of the eatery, "Ponpokorin", and Rin's foster father. Gin is a [URL=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kitsune]youko[/URL] with an "otherworldly" demeanour, and doesn't open up to anybody about his true feelings. He has a kind and gentle personality.

[Translation of his [URL=http://www.honeybee-cd.com/ayakashi/chara_gin.html]official website character profile[/URL].]
